authoritative.note: Japanese is the only text with legal effect. Current revision enforced 2025-09-01; earlier revision 2025-06-04 (without Chapters III and IV) deposited beside it. Supplementary Provisions are an extract (Articles 1 and 2 only).

source.versions: One text. Not amended since enactment as far as e-Gov records (no amending law on either revision). In force in two stages under Supplementary Provisions Article 1: from promulgation (2025-06-04), except Chapters III and IV and Supplementary Articles 3 and 4, which take effect on a day fixed by Cabinet Order within three months; e-Gov's current revision carries the enforcement date 2025-09-01 (the Cabinet Order itself is not deposited).
